resources.string: The phone did not recognize any words. Try again after the beep in the app’s selected language.
I heard “%1$s”, but could not match that command. Try “speak in Hindi” or “read the text”.
The phone could not use that recognition language. Try the wake phrase again and speak in the app’s selected language. You may need to download its speech recognition model.
Hands-free off. Enable once, then say “Hey SeeForYou” while the app is open. Commands may use your phone’s online speech service.
Say “Hey SeeForYou”, wait for the beep, then give a command.
Wake listening paused while the app speaks or uses voice input.
Wake listening unavailable. Turn hands-free off and on to retry.
Wake phrase heard. Wait for the beep.
No command received. Try again after the wake phrase.
Command not understood. Try “read the text”, “describe surroundings”, or “change the language to Hindi”.
The app language is now English.
Microphone permission is needed for hands-free commands.
Camera permission is needed to read text.
